title: MedQA-CS: Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE)-Style Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Clinical Skills
reasoning: The paper focuses on clinical skills benchmarking (MedQA-CS) for medical LLMs. While it includes 'compassion' as an evaluation rubric component for professional clinical communication, this is treated as a healthcare skill rather than a benchmark for religion, general ethics, or morals.
